rationale: Cross-tissue stiffness slopes show reproducible actomyosin direction, but this must be linked to function.
minimum_design: At least 3 independent donors; controlled stiffness/tension perturbation; contractility readout; Rho/ROCK perturbation.
success_rule: Reproducible functional mechanical phenotype attenuated by prespecified actomyosin perturbation.

success_rule: Mechanical phenotype attenuated by prespecified integrin perturbation after state controls.
